newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - JUNE 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - JUNE 20.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the June 21 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Japanese are trying to freeze Moscow out of economic meetings at the Denver summit.
- Russia's gas monopoly Gazprom, which is paying its dues to the budget, hopes the government will not forget about its own arrears to the company.
- Tatarstan is getting a firmer grip on the local truck producer Kamaz.
- Moscow seems to be angry with the way the leadership of the diamond-mining republic of Sakha-Yakutia manages the multi-billion dollar revenues the diamond industry brings.
- Russians are scared by the prospect of rent hikes.
- Film festivals in Russia are multiplying while domestic film production is in a freefall.
